content: Self-hosted WebAuthn RP pitfalls: WebAuthn requires TLS; if the reverse proxy terminates TLS and the app config still uses http:// as origin/rpId derivation source, registration fails. RP ID must be the eTLD+1 or exact hostname the BROWSER sees (public-facing domain via the proxy), never the internal container hostname - common Vaultwarden-behind-nginx failure mode. RP ID cannot be an IP address or bare public suffix.
